    • getChildrenRecursive

      public static Stream<SettingsChild> getChildrenRecursive(SettingsChild sc)
      Recursively retrieves all children settings, including those nested within SettingsParent objects. This method flattens the hierarchy into a single stream of SettingsChild objects.
      Parameters:
      sc - The starting SettingsChild from which to begin the recursive retrieval.
      Returns:
      A Stream of all SettingsChild objects found recursively.
